rows.jyutping: hoi1 sam1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe someone as extremely happy or overjoyed.

example.english: I was overjoyed when I received the gift.
example.traditional: 我收到份禮物，開心到不得了！
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou3 fan6 lai5 mat6 hoi1 sam1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5
